# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `clean-ai-labs-inc` MCP server pointing at Clean's hosted endpoint (`https://app.tryclean.ai/v1/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth or a Bearer API key from Clean **Settings → API**.
- Logo: `logo` references `https://www.tryclean.ai/clean-logo-blue.png`; the file could not be downloaded, so no local copy is committed.
